decision.question: What is the smallest set of box kinds that covers every real job?
decision.chose: Eight targets named by job: card (.card), frame (.surface with head/body/foot parts), region (.pad + .wash/.tint + .bleed), preview (core .page-preview), pill (.ui-pill), row (.ui-row, new), fold (details.ui-accordion-item), popover (.ux-popover).
over: Three targets only, the three spacing words (card, region, control): too coarse, a frame with head and foot bars and a floating menu are different jobs with different edges
Keep panel/dialog as its own target named panel: the word panel is already overloaded three ways (ext/Panel, .tab-panel, .ui-panel)
decision.why: Each target is one job with one padding rule; widgets (tables, trees, demos, the Panel editor) are not boxes and keep their shape.
decision.rule: framework.css spacing words; new-css-class 180 hand-rolled cards

decision.question: Which targets need a class that does not exist yet?
decision.chose: Two: .ui-row (a line in a list, owned by a new ui/row template) and .ui-panel-body (the padded body of a frame, owned by ui/panel). Both are drawn on the plan page from a stylesheet scoped to the page's after-column only.
over: Reuse .card for rows: a row has no border and pads in its own em
Put the body padding on .surface: then a picture or table in a frame would be padded too
decision.why: No existing class does either job; both sit in the ui- namespace their owning modules already hold.

decision.question: How does the plan page come to exist without editing more than the fence allows?
decision.chose: Added the word plan to ux/Content/page.js children (the same line, one word), plus one visible link card there and one link under the catalog's numbers.
over: Only a link line: a page not named in children: 404s, nothing crawls
decision.why: children: is what makes a page routable; the link lines make it reachable from where a reader already is.

decision.question: At 390 do before and after stack, or stay side by side?
decision.chose: Side by side at every width, each side 163px at 390; the three before-drawings wider than that (section band, three-column card, inbox tile) scroll inside their own stage.
over: Stack before above after on a phone: loses the side-by-side comparison the brief asks for
decision.why: The comparison is the point; a wide sample scrolling in its own stage is the catalog's existing behaviour.

decision.question: How is the visible change said in pixels?
decision.chose: Each pair is drawn in a box 30rem wide and the page measures where its first word lands (left and top) and the box height, live; count.mjs-style script wrote those numbers into each merge's visible_change.
over: Hand-typed padding values: --pad-card is a percentage of the box it sits in, so a typed number is wrong at another width
decision.why: Measured, never typed, same as the file and page counts.
